author: Jordan Ramée
description:
Soulframe still isn't out yet, but its Preludes were finally publicly opened on November 6, giving me my first chance to try it out. I was expecting "Warframe but fantasy," and to be fair, a lot of Soulframe is like that, but so much of Digital Extremes' new action-role-playing game feels very different. I'm floored--I've tried to get into Warframe several times and just kept bouncing off of it for one reason or another, but here I am really enjoying Soulframe and trying to figure out which live-service game I'm going to have to retire from to put Soulframe into my regular rotation. And it's really all because of the game's music.

Admittedly, music is one of the best parts about Warframe too. While I've never been able to really get into it, the reason I kept trying Warframe is because I'd keep hearing these a
title: I Love How Music Makes Soulframe Feel Like A Folktale

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 ditched traditional discs for its "physical" launch, with Rockstar's game being sold as a digital code-in-box at retailers beginning this week. However, it appears a packaging choice may have accidentally left the game vulnerable to thieves--assuming they have a flashlight.

As shared on the forum
title: “Physical” GTA 6 Copies Might Be Vulnerable To A Very Stupid But Serious Trick

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Recently, the gaming giant Electronic Arts was taken private in a $55 billion sale to an investor consortium led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. Could GTA 6 owner Take-Two be the next big company that gets acquired? Don't bet on it, CEO Strauss Zelnick says.

Speaking to David Rubenstein, Zelnick said Take-Two's business results have proven that it "can do very well as an independent company."

He said Take-Two's business is already "at scale" and healthy enough financially with a "terrific balance sheet," as he put it.
title: GTA 6 Owner Take-Two Is Not Interested In Selling Itself After EA Goes Private For $55 Billion

author: Ben Janca
description: In the Ocarina Of Time Remake, there are a vast amount of both old and new secrets, and we uncover many of them including hidden sound features right in the palm of your hand, some absolutely wild glitches, and some references that call back to some really cool sources.
title: 23 MORE Things You STILL Didn’t Know In Ocarina Of Time Remake

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and it's expected to be a gigantic commercial success, but just how big will the launch be? Investor's Business Daily compiled data from a series of analyst reports about the game and its owner, Take-Two, and the consensus is that it's going to be a juggernaut.

In terms of sales, Brian Pitz of BMO Capital Markets said GTA 6 could sell 55 million copies during Take-Two's fiscal 2027, which ends on March 31, 2027. He said the game could sell 45 millio
title: GTA 6 Could Sell 55 Million Copies By Early Next Year, Report Says, And Average Selling Price Could Be $90

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever has been in the wild for one week, and now we have all kinds of stats to sink our teeth into as they relate to the most popular races, classes, and faction in the latest version of developer Blizzard's MMORPG.

Forever launched November 4, becoming the biggest launch in WoW history by concurrent and returning players. Aside from that fact, Blizzard hasn't shared additional information on exactly how many characters have been made or what classes are most popular.

For that, we turn to Raider.IO, a WoW stat-tracking website more commonly used in the modern version of the game to provide rankings and details related to raids and Mythic+ progressi
title: You Can Probably Guess WoW: Forever’s Most Popular Race, Class, And Faction

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
MagicCon: Atlanta has kicked off with The Preview Panel, which usually shows off cards from future sets. While Nauctis: The Sunken Realm did feature during the panel, Wizards of the Coast then gave the Atlanta crowd more information on Planeswalker, the upcoming animated series set in the Magic multiverse, which is coming to Netflix in 2027.

The two-minute teaser highlighted the animation team at Hungary-based Digic Pictures, along with showrunner Terry Matalas, Magic head of story Roy Graham, and more. A few brief moments of Chandra and Ajani were mixed in with the behind-the-scenes footage, offering a first look at the upcoming show's animation style.

Pl
title: Magic: The Gathering Planeswalker Hits Netflix In 2027, Watch The Trailer Now

author: Paul Cecchini
description:
Super Mario 3D Land is celebrating its 15-year anniversary today, November 13, 2026. Below, we examine how 3D Land was a true iteration of the classic 2D Mario formula.

I remember when the first preview images of Super Mario 64 began circulating in gaming magazines. The thought of playing a Mario game in THREE DEEEEEE blew my tiny 8-year-old mind. While the final game was absolutely wonderful, it wasn’t quite what I had in my head when I thought about Mario gameplay translated into three dimensions. The worlds were vast and open-ended. Instead of running and jumping toward the goal, players had missions to accomplish. Puzzles to solve. Specific enemies to beat. Trinkets to find. Mario had a life bar. An air meter when underwater. Power-ups were temporary, vanishing after a certain time had elapsed.

And don’t get me wrong. It was different from what I imagined, but it worked. All of it worked. N
title: Super Mario 3D Land Dared To Embrace 2D Mario In A 3D World

author: Cameron Koch
description:
It's been just over a week since the record-breaking launch of World of Warcraft: Forever. In that time a handful of players have raced to level 60, but the overwhelming majority are still weeks away from reaching max level, as they quest through Azeroth and see all the new sights and sounds Blizzard has cooked up.

So far, it's been (mostly) an absolute joy. I've spent every spare moment I can find in developer Blizzard's millennial retirement home, and after one week, it's safe to say I'm more than a little consumed by it. I was already a lover of original WoW, having grown up playing it, and have since spent thousands of hours playing WoW Classic after it launched in 2019. Having a new version of this MMORPG, one that's still unexplored and filled with new sights and sounds, is in many ways a dream come true.
title: After A Week With WoW: Forever, Classic WoW Feels New Again

author: Chris Compendio
description:
Nintendo is celebrating The Legend of Zelda's 40th anniversary in many different ways, but one detail on the company's official website raised confusion--and curiosity-- about a classic 3DS Zelda game.

A "History" page on Nintendo's website lists every mainline Zelda game in release order, including the release date and which platforms you can play for each entry. The site marks every game that's playable for Nintendo Switch Online subscribers--and the 2013 3DS game The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds was marked as such. The NSO icon has since been removed from the site.

Currently, the Nintendo Classics library allows NSO subscribers to play select NES, SNES, and Game Boy games, while the Expansion Pack subscription includes access to Nintendo
title: Official Zelda Website Raises Eyebrows By Labeling 3DS Game As Playable On Switch

author: Eddie Makuch
description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and you'll have to pay at least $80 for it. That's a full $20 more than what GTA 5 cost in 2013 and $10 more than many other big AAA games today. Is $80 going to become the "new normal" for AAA games, or is it, along with Nintendo's Mario Kart World and Tears of the Kingdom for Switch 2, an outlier at $80?
title: GTA 6 And These Other Games Can Justify An $80 Price, Expert Says

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Everyone's favorite hockey-mask-wearing killer is finally set to return to the big screen for the first time in almost two decades, with a new film starring him set for release in 2027.

Per Deadline, veteran Friday the 13th director Steve Miner--who directed Friday the 13th: Part 2, Part 3, and the Halloween H20: 20 Years Later film that featured Jason's mask-wearing rival, Michael Myers--will helm this project. The Friday the 13th franchise has been largely absent from cinema, as a grueling battle over the franchise rights played out for years between screenwriter Victor Miller and production companies Horror, Inc. and the Manny Company (backed by original producer Sean S. Cunningham).

Fast-forward to 2026, and things have been settled. Miller has ownership of elements introduced in his ori
title: Friday The 13th Is Finally Returning To Movies, But Are Games Next?

author: Toby Arguello
description:
The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim celebrated its 15-year anniversary on November 11, 2026. Below, we look back at why it has endured for all that time.

It is my solemn duty to report that the first time someone booted up Skyrim was–brace yourself–15 years ago. I was 15 myself when I first took that infamously slow trip on the wagon toward my death-by-execution-turned-almost-death-by-dragon. Now in my 30s, Skyrim is still relevant. It sold 65 million copies. It is the most modded game on Nexus Mods, with some mods even becoming standalone games. It has inspired everything from Valheim to Avowed to Breath of the Wild. It’s so good, and so popular, that Bethesda has spent practically every year since release re-releasing it: for Switch, for VR, for the ‘Special Edition,’ for the ‘Anniversary Edition,’ spanning nine consoles across three entire generations.

I, like millions
title: Skyrim Is Not A Perfect Game, But 15 Years Later, There’s Still Nothing Like It

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar Games has released the first footage of an in-game GTA 6 TV show called "Macca & Friends," which is about a sunglass-wearing pink alligator and his wetland friends in Leonida (the stand-in for Florida).

One of Macca's friends is Pinchie the crab, who is Macca's landlord. Macca is also friends with a hat-wearing manatee and a flamingo. Check out the trailer below, which sets up a story where Macca needs to get money to pay his landlord. The story involves the group seemingly posing as cops and sneaking into a police station, maybe to grab some cash from an evidence locker?

Macca & Friends will be available to watch on Weazel, which is GTA'
title: GTA 6 In-Game TV Show Macca & Friends Looks Ridiculous In The Best Way

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Sony has announced that several more games are getting a Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) upgrade on PS5. Introduced in September, QSSR is an AI-guided upscaling technology similar to the PS5 Pro's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), and it originally supported only Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei. That lineup is expanding over the next couple of weeks to include games like Control Resonant, Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Arc Raiders, The Finals, No Man's Sky, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam.

While it's not quite as good as PSSR on the PS5 Pro, QSSR still does a noticeable job of adding detail and clarity without impacting performance. Sony added that since QSSR shares elements with PSSR, it makes games that sup
title: The PS5’s New Graphics-Upscaling Trick Is Spreading To More Games

author: Ben Janca
description:
This is the second trailer introducing the life of protagonist Makoto Daito, whose story unfolds across five eras and five cities from 1915 to 1965. More story trailers are still to come. As each era unfolds, you’ll discover the people and pivotal moments that will shape his fate. Stay tuned.

Act 2: Kure
Makoto Daito joins the Iwaki family following an attack on its patriarch, Genzo Iwaki, and begins his rise through the yakuza ranks. As he becomes known as the “Red Oni,” we also see Daito wrestle with his life in the yakuza and confront the choices he has made.

STRANGER THAN HEAVEN releases on January 15, 2027.
title: Stranger Than Heaven – Act 2: Kure Story Overview Trailer

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Xbox Cloud Gaming now has a free ad-supported version that's rolling out as part of Microsoft's bigger push to bring more ads to Xbox. Jonathan Stringfield, who worked on Activision's advertising push and is now doing some of the same work in his title as GM for Xbox Media Solutions, said in an interview that people shouldn't see this as a move by Xbox to cram ads into all of its games.

“There is zero world where there is intention--written, explicit, implicit, or otherwise--that ads will be an option in all games. It might not even be the case on all features of the console, et cetera,” he told
title: Xbox Says Putting Ads In Games, Something No One Likes, Could Help Save Gaming

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
When thinking of the creative inspirations behind HoYoverse's upcoming cozy lifesim, Petit Planet, there are some things that instantly spring to mind. The development team has already acknowledged whimsical influences such as the children's fable, The Little Prince, and comparisons to genre titan Animal Crossing: New Horizons follow the game wherever it goes.

However, speaking to GameSpot during HoYoverse's recent media week in Seoul, South Korea, lead game designer Murphy revealed an artistic inspiration that caught us completely off guard: Amazon Prime's hit documentary reality series, Clarkson's Farm.

When asked if the developers had looked at other works of children's media or childhood nostalgia when creating Petit Planet, Murphy explained that former Top Gear host Jeremy Clarkson's a
title: Why Clarkson’s Farm Is An Unlikely Inspiration For HoYoverse’s Cozy Game Petit Planet

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: After quickly selling out earlier this year, Microsoft dropped a limited number of its 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X consoles for sale this week--aaaaannnd they're already gone. Easily the best-looking Xbox Series X console thanks to its transparent green case, it looks like the majority of people looking to get one of these are out of luck, unless they're willing to pony up and pay extra for one of these consoles on sites like eBay, where they're currently being listed at next-gen console prices.
title: The Xbox 25th Anniversary Console Restock Sold Out Before You Could Finish Reading This Headline

author: Callum Self
description:
I don’t think there’s ever been a more iconic sound than the ‘!’ noise that triggers when you’re spotted in Metal Gear Solid. Even when I was a little kid, my first exposure to the franchise was through the Mesal Gear Solid: Snake Escape minigame in Ape Escape 3. That’s not really relevant, besides the fact that it shares a similar name with Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater, a remake and an absolute blast that’s now cheaper than ever, with all DLC included.

If you ask anyone who has played the series, there’s a good chance that Snake Eater might be their favorite. Personally, I’m a sucker for The Phantom Pain and, of course, Metal Gear Rising—but a majority of fans love this one, and I can’t blame them. A prequel to the rest of the series, meaning it’s a perfect jumping-on point for interest
title: Get Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater And All Bonus DLC Cheaper Than The Standard Edition Right Now

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Saying Overwatch 2 has had a rocky road since its 2019 reveal would be an understatement, and former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan isn't a fan of how the game was first announced.

Speaking to Gaming World Interviews, Kaplan didn't mince words about the BlizzCon 2019 opening ceremony, where Overwatch 2 was shown for the first time, as Blizzard promised numerous features it either walked back or didn't deliver.

Kaplan said that from 2018 until his departure, he experienced constant friction with Blizzard's executive leadership over game direction, scheduling, and core game mechanics. This led him to confront leadership about the lack of a clear vision or business model for Overwatch 2, and to question the wisdom of announcing Over
title: “You Guys Are F***ing Idiots”: Jeff Kaplan Takes Aim At Blizzard’s Overwatch 2 Reveal

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Amid a modest 25th-anniversary celebration, Xbox dropped a new preview of the Fable reboot. This snippet — which runs for under four minutes — offers plenty of gameplay and a closer look at some of the ghoulish enemies you'll face, set in a slice of Albion that looks surprisingly grim compared to the lighthearted Fable teasers that came before it.

"The Hero of Briar Hill has entered the depths of Deepwood alongside Arden, a local Hero, to investigate why strange magical happenings have been troubling the people of Oakshire," the video synopsis reads. "Here, they cross a threshold where the natural magic of Deepwood appears corrupted by an outside force, and they discover hints as to who or what could be responsible."
title: Fable Is Looking A Lot Darker Than We Expected

author: Hayley Williams
description:
The long-rumored Wolfenstein 3 has been officially confirmed to be in development at MachineGames. The news follows many hints and rumors of a third game in MachineGames' planned Wolfenstein trilogy, the franchise's first new entry since Wolfenstein: Youngblood in 2019 and its first mainline title since 2017.

Xbox CEO Asha Shar posted the announcement as part of Xbox's 25th anniversary celebrations, and Bethesda also shared the news in its own post.

In a move borrowed from the film industry, the game announceme
title: Wolfenstein 3 Is Officially In Production At MachineGames
